# Boluwatife Osineye

> Full-stack engineer based in Nigeria. Builds React Native, React and Next.js apps for logistics, payments and commerce. Has mentored 97+ developers. Open to full-time and contract work, remote. Also runs Klinfits, a live clothing shop with an AI operations agent built on Claude.

Site: https://boluwatifeosineye.com

## Roles

- ISDS, Frontend Developer (Jul 2025 – Oct 2026): led frontend delivery (wallet, checkout, performance) across four Insta-Delivery apps.
- Imagine Integrated, Mobile Developer (Jan 2025 – Jul 2025)
- Sabi Programmers (2024)

## Projects

- Klinfits ops agent: an AI operations agent (Claude, tool use) inside the private Telegram bot of my own shop, Klinfits. It turns a pasted WhatsApp order into a priced payment link that I approve with one tap. Live.
  - Case study: https://boluwatifeosineye.com/work/klinfits-ops-agent
  - Shop: https://www.klinfits.shop/
- Insta-Delivery Customer (ISDS), live on the App Store, with wallet funding and P2P transfers: https://apps.apple.com/ng/app/insta-delivery-by-isds/id6746375381
- Insta-Delivery Vendors (ISDS), live on the App Store; orders, dispatch, earnings, withdrawals and payouts: https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/insta-delivery-vendors/id6748257517
- Insta-Delivery Driver (ISDS), live on the App Store; riders go online, take jobs and prove drop-off: https://apps.apple.com/ar/app/insta-delivery-driver/id6747667869?l=en-GB
- ISDS Customer B2B: bulk local, international and multi-drop shipments. In development, not launched.
- Fitnex: live PWA, 200+ active users. Workout logging and progress tracking, works offline. Built solo and still maintained: https://fitnexonline.com
- Cartify: demo storefront with Stripe checkout and Clerk sign-in.
  - Demo: https://next-ecommerce-eta-nine.vercel.app
  - Source: https://github.com/heistifeh/next-ecommerce
